notes: SLOT 10 (00:35 IST fire, reported 00:36 IST / 2026-09-21 19:06 UTC) - WORK SLOT. Item 13 (zero-fake-success sweep) extended to the Computer Operator / Screen Researcher panel. ComputerOperatorModal.tsx rendered three unmeasured live-screen claims even when the host was unobservable (probeHostState() returns observed:false on this headless container, and describeHostScreen() correctly sets isAmbiguous:true): (1) a green dot with the literal 'STANDBY: SCREEN SYNCHRONIZED', drawn from the mere absence of a running task; (2) the resolution badge printed screenResolution.width x height, which is 0x0 for an unobservable host; (3) a field labelled 'Resolution:' whose value was currentObservation.platform || 'linux-arm64' - a platform name presented as a measured dimension. New src/utils/computerOperator/observationTruth.ts derives all three from the real observation: screenSyncState()/screenSyncLabel() hold at ILLUSTRATIVE (preview) or UNOBSERVED (absent/ambiguous) and only report 'SCREEN OBSERVED FROM HOST' for a real observation; observationResolutionLabel() returns UNKNOWN instead of 0x0; observationPlatformLabel() labels the platform as a platform; observationAmbiguityNotice() surfaces the host ambiguityReason. State dot now red for UNOBSERVED / grey for ILLUSTRATIVE, never green. Guard: src/tests/observationTruth.test.ts (19 tests) - observed passing. Negative-validated: reintroducing 'STANDBY: SCREEN SYNCHRONIZED' fails exactly the source guard (observed 1 failed | 18 passed); restored, re-observed 19/19. Observed gates: npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npx vitest run 64 files / 922 tests passed; npm run build exit 0 (dist/server.cjs 843115 bytes / 823.4 kb). Commits 61ad02e (fix), 8e874a4 (docs), 2a116fc (window log) pushed to origin/feature/hermes-full-completion. Item 13 stays PARTIAL - pattern-driven sweep, not proof no unmeasured claim survives.
